title: GA4GH IO Profile Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for validating GA4GH workflow and tool IO JSON Schema profiles.

inputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected input parameters for the workflow or tool.

outputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected output structure from the workflow or tool.

ga4gh-extensions.description: Custom GA4GH annotations for execution APIs and UI rendering.

x-ga4gh-drs-uri.description: Indicates if a string field is expected to be a valid DRS URI.

x-ga4gh-ontology.description: URI to an ontology term (e.g., EDAM format) semantically describing the data type.

x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.description: A nested JSON schema to validate the internal row/column structure of a tabular file.

x-ga4gh-ui-widget.description: Hint for UI clients on how to render this input/output. References an external standardized vocabulary.

x-ga4gh-fa-icon.description: Inspired by nf-core. FontAwesome icon class to display next to the parameter in dynamic UIs.

x-ga4gh-description-format.description: Hint for UI/CLI clients on how to parse and render the standard JSON Schema 'description' field, avoiding redundant text properties.

x-ga4gh-hidden.description: Inspired by nf-core. If true, UI generators should hide this parameter from default user views.

x-ga4gh-error-message.description: Inspired by nf-core. Custom, human-readable error message to display if WES payload validation fails.
